name: Z.ai (GLM)
summary: Chat assistant from Zhipu AI powered by its GLM models, with coding and agent features.
description: Z.ai is the assistant and model platform from Zhipu AI, built on its GLM family of models. The chat app answers questions, writes code, builds simple websites and handles longer multi-step tasks. The company also releases GLM models with open weights. Its subscription page lists Lite, Pro and Max plans starting at $18 per month, with team seats priced separately. Whether the basic chat remains free was not stated on the pages checked.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Z.AI's pricing page lists per-token prices, including GLM-5.3 at $1.40 per million input tokens, and marks GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash as free. The coding plan documented separately starts at $18/month.
